observations: Photo 0: a cream or off-white fabric sofa seen from above, about two seats wide, with one long seat cushion and rounded tub-style arms and back.
Photo 1: the same sofa from the side; upholstery looks intact with no visible tears, but faint greyish marks show on the backrest and slight soiling on the seat.
No brand label, tag or plate is visible in either photo.
The legs, base, underside and rear of the sofa are not shown; the floor around the base is partly hidden.
Both photos carry a 'POSTED ON JIJI GREGEZE97' watermark; no ruler or tape measure in shot, so size is judged from the room only.

read_from: photo 0 overall shape and seat width

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a single long seat cushion about two seats wide.
Fabric looks intact in photos 0 and 1, but photo 1 shows faint marks on the backrest and seat; underside, legs and back not shown.

risks.risk: Stains or soiling on light fabric beyond what the angles show, especially on the back and arm fronts
risks.proof: Close-up photos in daylight of the seat, backrest and both arm fronts

risks.risk: Broken or wobbly frame, or damaged legs, hidden by the camera angle
risks.proof: A short clip of the sofa tipped or lifted showing the legs and underside, and someone sitting and shifting on it
A clip of a person sitting down on both halves of the seat, viewed from the front

risks.risk: Pests such as bedbugs in fabric seams
risks.proof: Close-up of the seams and underside lining
risks.if_unproven: as needing treatment, at the worst case of the type

risks.risk: Actual width may be smaller than a standard 2 seater
risks.proof: Full front photo with a tape measure across the width

proof_requests: Full front photo of the whole sofa in daylight with a tape measure across its width
Clip showing the legs, underside and back of the sofa
Close-ups of the faint marks on the backrest and seat
Clip of someone sitting on each half of the seat
response.reason: The photos clearly show a cream fabric 2 seater sofa, which is priced by type. Unseen frame, legs and stains are priced at the worst case until the seller sends the listed shots.
